channel.title: Field notes on data and AI agents · Vishal Kumar Sarvade
channel.description: A short daily note on how companies are putting AI agents to work, plus longer posts on Redshift and data architecture. Every source is linked.

item.title: McKinsey: oversight was 70 to 75% of a bank agent's run costs
item.description: McKinsey's review of agentic AI in financial-crime work finds tokens are 20 to 25 percent of variable run costs in one banking task, while human oversight is 70 to 75 percent.

item.title: Arrakis: 76% of AI agents sat idle 60 days with credentials still live
item.description: Arrakis Security telemetry from thousands of production agents found 76% had not run in 60 days while their credentials still worked, and 82% carried at least one exposure.

item.title: SK Telecom gives AI agents employee IDs, owners and a retirement path
item.description: SK Telecom's first AI Governance Report gives in-house agents employee IDs and named supervisors, tracks token use and performance, and sets a 2026 to 2028 roadmap toward full lifecycle management.

item.title: OutSystems survey: 82% trust their agent governance, 5% automate it
item.description: In an OutSystems, CIO Dive and KPMG survey of 858 executives, 82% said they can keep pace with governing AI agents, yet only 5% have automated controls, audit trails and formal human review points.

item.title: AAIF takes in Agent Skills and Open Responses, now hosts 10 projects
item.description: The Agentic AI Foundation added four donated projects from Anthropic, OpenAI, Hugging Face and Alibaba, growing from three projects to 10 in its first year. Neutral governance is still unproven.

item.title: Customers Bancorp: agents doubled, but hours saved are self-reported
item.description: Customers Bancorp reported a 95% cut in loan underwriting cycle time and 76,000 estimated hours saved. Its footnotes show the hours are self-reported and agents include custom GPTs.

item.title: Study models 290% ROI for agents built on a governed data layer
item.description: A Veqtor8 study announced by Denodo models a 290% three year ROI and a 68% cut in AI operating costs when agents query a governed data layer instead of custom integrations.

item.title: Gartner: only 13% of CIOs report significant value from AI
item.description: A Gartner survey of 2,002 CIOs found only 13% have realized significant or transformational value from AI, and just 17% have rules for shutting down low-value AI work already in production.

item.title: Nylas: 54% of companies saw an AI agent error in the last 90 days
item.description: A Nylas survey of 1,030 US professionals found 54% had an AI agent make a mistake in the past 90 days, rising to 70% among teams running more than 20 agents.

item.title: CERT-In: agents under test reached live systems through exposed keys
item.description: India's CERT-In says AI agents under evaluation read live business records through exposed credentials, and no affected organisation noticed. Its advisory asks for logs kept at least 180 days.

item.title: Redshift data sharing: what producer and consumer clusters really share
item.description: Data sharing let us retire the sync jobs between four Redshift clusters. It isolates compute well. It does not make the producer invisible, and that is the part worth planning for.
